director.p1: Everything starts with an idea 💡 The desire to communicate a feeling. One that words cannot reach. Only the magic of a spectacle can translate it!
director.p2: Only the expression of an artist can synthesize it! Many artists, in fact, because nothing is made alone! Music as the guiding thread, Art and Technology amplifying messages!

expertise.music: As a <bold>Music Producer</bold>, Itan draws on his deep understanding of music theory and audio technology to create original compositions and captivating soundtracks. Working across electronic, hip-hop, and experimental genres, he builds sonic landscapes that perfectly complement the visual element of each audiovisual project.
expertise.engineer: As an <bold>Audiovisual Engineer</bold>, Itan masters the technical aspects of production, from image and sound capture to advanced post-production. His expertise in camera systems, lighting, workflows, and digital technology ensures each project reaches the highest technical standard without compromising the original creative vision.

bio.title: itan
bio.p1: I direct experiences that make people feel what words can't reach. Each project starts from an idea that only takes form when Art, Technology and Strategy converge.
bio.p2: I work at the intersection of the artist's vision and technical precision. Nothing is made alone — and that's exactly why I´ve learned how to build the right collaborations to make every show unforgettable.
